fields.name: Rates
fields.text: This node contains child elements of type Rate. If the rate is constant over the life of the fixed leg, only one rate value should be entered. If two or more coupons have different rates, multiple rate values are required, each represented by a Rate child element. The first rate value corresponds to the first coupon, the second rate value corresponds to the second coupon, etc. If the number of coupons exceeds the number of rate values, the rate will be kept flat at the value of last entered rate for the remaining coupons. The number of entered rate values cannot exceed the number of coupons. Allowable values: Each child element can take any real number. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 0.05 is a rate of 5%. As in the case of notionals, the rate schedule can be specified with dates as shown in Listing the guide. \begin{listing}[H] %\hrule\medskip \begin{minted}[fontsize=\footnotesize]{xml} <FixedLegData> <Rates> <Rate>0.05</Rate> <Rate startDate='2016-02-04'>0.05</Rate> <Rate startDate='2019-02-05'>0.05</Rate> </Rates> </FixedLegData>

fields.name: Index
fields.text: The combination of currency, index and term that identifies the relevant fixings and yield curve of the floating leg. Allowable values: An alphanumeric string of the form CCY-INDEX-TENOR. CCY, INDEX and TENOR must be separated by dashes (-). CCY and INDEX must be among the supported currency and index combinations. TENOR must be an integer followed by D, W, M or Y. See Table the guide. TENOR is not required for Overnight indices, but can be set to 1D.

fields.name: IsInArrears
fields.text: true indicates that fixing is in arrears, false indicates that fixing is in advance. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: IsAveraged
fields.text: For cases where there are multiple index fixings over a period true indicates that the average of the fixings is used to calculate the coupon. false indicates that the coupon is calculated by compounding the fixings. IsAveraged only applies to Overnight indices and Sub Periods Coupons. Allowable values: true, false. Defaults to false if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: HasSubPeriods
fields.text: For cases where several Ibor fixings result in a single payment for a period, e.g. if the Ibor tenor is 3M and the schedule tenor is 6M, two fixings are used to compute the amount of the semiannual coupon payments. true indicates that an average (IsAveraged = true) or a compounded (IsAveraged=false) value of the fixings is used to determine the payment rate. false indicates that the initial index period fixing determines the payment rate for the full tenor, i.e. no further fixings, no averaging and no compounding. IsAveraged is ignored for Ibor legs when HasSubPeriods is set to false. HasSubPeriods does not apply to Overnight indices. Allowable values: true, false. Defaults to false if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: IncludeSpread
fields.text: Only applies to Sub Periods and (compounded) OIS Coupons. If true the spread is included in the compounding, otherwise it is excluded. Allowable values: true, false. Defaults to false if left blank or omitted. A Zero Coupon Floating leg with compounding that includes spread can be set up using a rules-based schedule as shown in Listing the guide. Note that the Tenor in the rules-based schedule is not used when Rule is set to Zero. \begin{listing}[H] %\hrule\medskip \begin{minted}[fontsize=\footnotesize]{xml} <LegData> <LegType>Floating</LegType> <Payer>false</Payer> <Currency>USD</Currency> <Notionals> <Notional>200000.0000</Notional> </Notionals> <DayCounter>A360</DayCounter> <PaymentConvention>MF</PaymentConvention> <ScheduleData> <Rules> <StartDate>2020-01-14</StartDate> <EndDate>2020-07-14</EndDate> <Tenor>3M</Tenor> <Calendar>USD</Calendar> <Convention>MF</Convention> <TermConvention>MF</TermConvention> <Rule>Zero</Rule> </Rules> </ScheduleData> <FloatingLegData> <Index>USD-LIBOR-3M</Index> <IsAveraged>false</IsAveraged> <HasSubPeriods>true</HasSubPeriods> <IncludeSpread>true</IncludeSpread> <Spreads> <Spread>0.006500</Spread> </Spreads> <IsInArrears>false</IsInArrears> <FixingDays>2</FixingDays> </FloatingLegData> </LegData>

fields.name: RoundingPrecision
fields.text: [Optional] The number of decimal places to which the interpolated fixing percentage is rounded, e.g. RoundingPrecision 2 rounds 2.341% to 2.34% (Closest). If omitted, no rounding is applied.

fields.name: DocClause
fields.text: The documentation clause that is applicable for the specified reference entity in the credit derivative. This defines what constitutes a credit event for the contract as well as any limitations on the deliverable debt in the event of a credit event. Table the guide provides the allowable values.

fields.name: StrictComparison
fields.text: 0, 1. Defaults to 0. Determines how the barrier is checked as per: 0: the barrier checks use <=, >=. 1: the barrier checks use strict comparison < and >.

fields.name: Style
fields.text: Specifies the monitoring style of the barrier. Optional, if not given, defaults to the supported barrier style (see table the guide and if both American and European barriers are supported, defaults to American. \\ Allowable values: American, European.

fields.name: Rebate
fields.text: The barrier rebate is a fixed amount, expressed in domestic / sold currency paid out to the option holder if a barrier option expires inactive, i.e. it is not knocked in/out. Note that Rebate is supported for \begin{itemize}

fields.name: Underlyings
fields.text: The basket of underlyings. \\ For FxBasketVarianceSwap, Type is set to FX and Name is a string of the form SOURCE-CCY1-CCY2 where CCY1 is the foreign currency, CCY2 is the domestic currency, and SOURCE is the fixing source, see Table the guide. (section Data Node / Index) for allowable values. For EquityBasketVarianceSwap, Type is set to Equity and Name and other fields are as outlined in the guide. For CommodityBasketVarianceSwap, Type is set to Commodity and Name is an identifier of the commodity as outlined in the guide and in Table the guide Allowable values: For each underlying, an Underlying node as outlined in the guide. All underlyings must be from the same asset class.

fields.name: ReferenceSecurity
fields.text: The ISIN of the Asset Backed Security tranche to which the BGS is linked. Allowable values: The prefix ISIN: followed by an ISIN code for the Reference Security.

fields.name: Tranches
fields.text: A description of the Asset Backed Security tranche notionals. Each Tranche is identified by a SecurityId and an optional Description. Each Tranche has a Seniority given as a positive integer value where lower values mean higher seniority, i.e. 1 is the most senior tranche (e.g. "class A") followed by 2 (e.g. "class B") etc. The notionals are given in a sub-node Notionals as described in section the guide w.r.t. a schedule given in ScheduleData which is shared across all tranches. There must be exactly one tranche with a security id matching the reference security.

fields.name: LegData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. A BGS must have two LegData nodes and the LegType element must be set to Floating on one leg and Fixed on the other. The two legs must have the same Currency.

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: The OptionData node is as described in Section the guide. The relevant fields in the OptionData node for a BondFutureOption are: \begin{itemize}

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide Option Data. Note that the bond option type allows for European option style only.

fields.name: StrikeData
fields.text: A node containing the strike information. Allowable values: Supports StrikePrice and StrikeYield as described in Section the guide.

fields.name: Redemption
fields.text: Redemption ratio in percent

fields.name: PriceType
fields.text: This node defines which strike should be used for the pricing. If the node takes the value Dirty, the strike price should be set equal to the value of the Strike node. If the node takes the value Clean, the strike price should be set equal to the value of the Strike node plus accrued interest at the expiration date of the option.\\ Allowable values: Dirty or Clean.

fields.name: KnocksOut
fields.text: If true the option knocks out if the underlying defaults before the option expiry, if false the option is written on the recovery value in case of a default of the bond before the option expiry

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. The exercise dates specify the dates on which one of the counterparties may terminate the swap. The counterpart holding the call right is specified by the LongShort flag. The Settlement should be set to Physical always. See also the OptionData node outlined for a Swaption - see the guide, which is identical for a CallableSwap with the exception of the requirement that Settlement must be Physical, and that the leg directions on a CallableSwap are from the perspective of the client, whereas they are from the perspective of the party that is long on a Swaption. A callable swap can be marked as exercised as explained in the guide using the ExerciseData node within OptionData. Note that if an exercise triggers the exchange of notionals in a cross currency callable swap, this exchange must be captured as two exercise fees in the respective currencies.

fields.name: LegData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node described in section the guide outlining each leg of the underlying Swap. A Callable Swap must have at least one leg on the underlying Swap, but can have multiple legs, i.e. multiple LegData nodes. The LegType elements must be of types Floating, Fixed, Cashflow or RangeAccrual. Cross currency underlyings are supported. Note that the direction of the legs, determined by the Payer tag, is like for a Swap, from the perspective of the party to the trade. I.e. unlike for a Swaption where the direction of the legs is from the perspective of the party that is long.

fields.name: LongShort
fields.text: This node defines the position in the cap (floor, collar) and can take values Long or Short.

fields.name: LegData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. Exactly one LegData node is allowed, and the LegType element must be set to Floating (Ibor and OIS), CMS, CMSSpread, DurationAdjustedCMS, CPI or YY.

fields.name: Caps
fields.text: This node has child elements of type Cap capping the floating leg (after applying spread if any). The first rate value corresponds to the first coupon, the second rate value corresponds to the second coupon, etc. If the number of coupons exceeds the number of rate values, the rate will be kept flat at the value of last entered rate for the remaining coupons. For a fixed cap rate over all coupons, one single rate value is sufficient. The number of entered rate values cannot exceed the number of coupons. Allowable values for each Cap element: Any real number. The rate is expressed in decimal form, eg 0.05 is a rate of 5%

fields.name: Floors
fields.text: This node has child elements of type Floor flooring the floating leg (after applying spread if any). The first rate value corresponds to the first coupon, the second rate value corresponds to the second coupon, etc. If the number of coupons exceeds the number of rate values, the rate will be kept flat at the value of last entered rate for the remaining coupons. For a fixed floor rate over all coupons, one single rate value is sufficient. The number of entered rate values cannot exceed the number of coupons. Allowable values for each Floor element: Any real number. The rate is expressed in decimal form, eg 0.05 is a rate of 5%

fields.name: Premiums
fields.text: Option premium amounts paid by the option buyer to the option seller. Allowable values: See section the guide

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The currency of cash position. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: Amount
fields.text: The amount of cash position. \\ Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: PayCurrency
fields.text: The settlement currency for the payment cashflow. \\ Allowable values: See Currency in Table the guide.

fields.name: FXIndex
fields.text: The FX reference index for determining the FX fixing at the value date. The Forward Price will be observed at maturity date (or future expiry date if it’s a future), the NPV is converted to PayCurrency with the FXIndex using an FX fixing on FixingDate (settlement date) discounted from PaymentDate. \\ Allowable values: The format of the FXIndex is "FX-FixingSource-CCY1-CCY2" as described in Table the guide.

fields.name: FixingDate
fields.text: The date on which the FXIndex is observed. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: Position
fields.text: Defines whether the underlying commodity will be bought (long) or sold (short). \\ Allowable values: Long, Short

fields.name: Maturity
fields.text: The maturity date of the forward contract, i.e. the date when the underlying commodity will be bought/sold. \\ Allowable values: Any date string, see Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: Name
fields.text: The name of the underlying commodity. \\ Allowable values: See Name for commodity trades in Table the guide. \\

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The currency the underlying commodity is quoted in. The Strike and the Forward price (or Future price) of the underlying commodity are both considered to be in this currency. \\ Allowable values: See Currency in Table the guide.

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: The agreed buy/sell price of the commodity forward. \\ Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.text: The number of units of the underlying commodity to be bought/sold. \\ Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: IsFuturePrice
fields.text: This should be set to true if the forward contract underlying is the settlement price of a commodity future contract. If omitted, it defaults to false. \\ Allowable values: Any string that evaluates to true or false as outlined in Table the guide.

fields.name: FutureExpiryDate
fields.text: If IsFuturePrice is set to true, this gives the expiration date of the underlying commodity future contract. If omitted, the expiration date of the underlying commodity future contract is set equal to the value in the Maturity node. If FutureExpiryDate is provided, it takes precedence over any value provided in the Maturity, FutureExpiryOffset or FutureExpiryOffsetCalendar fields. \\ Allowable values: Any date string, see Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: FutureExpiryOffset
fields.text: If IsFuturePrice is set to true and FutureExpiryDate is not explicitly specified, this gives the offset period that should be applied to the Maturity date to generate the underlying commodity future contract expiration date. If omitted, the expiration date of the underlying commodity future contract is set equal to the value in the Maturity node. \\ Allowable values: Any string that can be parsed as a period e.g.\ 2D, 3M, etc.

fields.name: FutureExpiryOffsetCalendar
fields.text: If FutureExpiryOffset is provided and is being used, this gives the calendar that should be used when generating the underlying commodity future contract expiration date from the Maturity date. If omitted, all days are considered good business days when generating the commodity future contract expiration date which is generally not what is desired. \\ Allowable values: Any calendar string, see Calendar in Table the guide.

fields.name: PhysicallySettled
fields.text: A value of true indicates that the forward contract is physically settled e.g.\ if the underlying is a future contract, that future contract is entered into on the Maturity date. A value of false indicates that the forward contract is cash settled e.g.\ if the underlying is a future contract, that future contract settlement price is observed on the Maturity date (or the FutureExpiryDate, when given) and the net amount due is exchanged on the cash settlement date. If omitted, it defaults to true. \\ Allowable values: Any string that evaluates to true or false as outlined in Table the guide.

fields.name: PaymentDate
fields.text: If PhysicallySettled is set to false, this gives the cash settlement date. It must be greater than or equal to the Maturity date. If omitted and the forward is cash settled, the Maturity date is used. \\ Allowable values: Any date string, see Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: SettlementData
fields.text: This node is used to specify the settlement of the cash flows for cash settled forwards, and the payment flow for physically settled ones.

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: Defines the currency the NPV of the composite trade will be represented in. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: NotionalCalculation
fields.text: The method by which the notional of the composite trade will be calculated. \\ Allowable values: \begin{itemize}

fields.name: NettingSetId
fields.text: The NettingSetId element specifies the identifier for a netting set. If a NettingSetId is specified, the trade is eligible for close-out netting under the terms of an associated ISDA agreement. The specified NettingSetId must be defined within the netting set definitions file (see section the guide). If left blank or omitted the trade will not belong to any netting set, and thus not be eligible for netting. Allowable values: Any alphanumeric string. Underscores (_) and blank spaces may be used as well. % -- specified netting --Negative transaction values offset exposures from positive transaction values within specified % netting groups. Total netting % group %-- exposures and exposures from transactions not belonging to a netting group are then combined without offsetting.

fields.name: PortfolioIds
fields.text: The PortfolioIds node allows the assignment of a given trade to several portfolios, each enclosed in its own pair of tags <PortfolioId> and </PortfolioId> . Note that ORE does not assume a hierarchical organisation of such portfolios. If present, the portfolio IDs will be used in the generation of some ORE reports such as the VaR report which provides breakdown by any portfolio id that occurs in the trades' envelopes. Allowable values for each PortfolioId: Any string.

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.text: The AdditionalFields node allows the insertion of additional trade information using custom XML elements. For example, elements such as Sector, Desk or Folder can be used. The elements within the AdditionalFields node are used for informational purposes only, and do not affect any analytics in ORE. Allowable values: Any custom element.

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. Note that the Equity Barrier Option type allows for European option style only.

fields.name: BarrierData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. Level specified in BarrierData should be quoted in the same currency with the underlying Equity spot price. Changing the option from Call to Put or vice versa does not require switching the barrier level.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.text: The start date for checking if a barrier has been breached prior to today's date. If omitted or left blank no check is made and it is assumed no barrier has been breached in the past. Has no impact if set to today's date or a date in the future. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: Calendar
fields.text: The calendar associated with the Equity Index. Required if StartDate is set to a date prior to today's date, otherwise optional. Allowable values: See Table the guide Calendar.

fields.name: EQIndex
fields.text: A reference to an Equity Index source to check if the barrier has been breached. Required if StartDate is set to a date prior to today's date, otherwise optional and can be omitted but not left blank. Allowable values: The format of the Equity Index is"EQ-RIC:Code".

fields.name: Underlying
fields.text: This node may be used as an alternative to the Name node to specify the underlying equity. This in turn defines the equity curve used for pricing. The Underlying node is described in further detail in Section the guide.

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The payment currency of the trade. Allowable values: See Currency and Minor Currencies in Table the guide. This should be equal to the underlying equity except for the major / minor distinction. I.e. quanto payoffs that are usually identified by setting the payment currency to a different currency than the underlying equity currency, are not allowed for this trade type.

fields.name: StrikeData
fields.text: A node containing the strike in Value and the currency in which both the underlying and the strike are quoted in Currency. I.e. compo options with strike currency not equal to underlying equity currency are not supported for this trade type. Allowable values: Only supports StrikePrice as described in Section the guide.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.text: The number of units of the underlying covered by the transaction. Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. The relevant fields in the OptionData node for an EquityDigitalOption are: \begin{itemize}

fields.name: FXIndex
fields.text: The FX reference index for determining the FX fixing at the value date. The Forward Price will be observed at maturity date (or future expiry date if it’s a future), the NPV is converted to PayCurrency with the FXIndex using an FX fixing on FixingDate (settlement date) discounted from PaymentDate. \\ Allowable values: The format of the FXIndex is "FX-FixingSource-CCY1-CCY2" as described in Table the guide.

fields.name: Date
fields.text: If specified, this will be the payment date. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide. If left blank or omitted, the payment date will be derived from the maturity date applying the PaymentLag, PaymentCalendar and the PaymentConvention as defined in the Rules sub-node.

fields.name: Rules
fields.text: If Date is left blank or omitted, this node will be used to derive the payment date from the maturity date. The Rules sub-node is shown in Listing the guide, and the meanings and allowable values of its elements follow below. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. The relevant fields in the OptionData node for an EquityDoubleTouchOption are as below. Note that the OptionType can be omitted. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: Volatility
fields.text: The hedging volatility \sigma_h used in the Black--Scholes delta computation for the daily delta-hedge rebalancing. Expressed as a decimal (e.g.\ 0.05 for 5%). Allowable values: any non-negative real number.

fields.name: DriftRate
fields.text: The continuously compounded rate r used in the contractual forward formula F_{t,T} = S_t \cdot e^{r\,\tau}, where \tau is the Actual/365 (Fixed) year fraction from observation date to expiry. Allowable values: any real number (typically 0.00).

fields.name: Underlyings
fields.text: A container node holding one or more Underlying child nodes. Each Underlying defines a single batch of options within the auto delta hedged structure. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: OptionData

fields.name: Name
fields.text: The name of the Underlying asset. Allowable values: Equity: See Name for equity trades in Table the guide FX: A string on the form SOURCE-CCY1-CCY2, where SOURCE is the FX fixing source, and the fixing is expressed as amount in CCY2 per one unit of CCY1. Commodity: An identifier specifying the commodity being referenced in the leg. % The following needs to move into client-specific documentation of allowable values: %The Name is of the form Prefix:Identifier. For precious metals, the Identifier is the precious metal code followed by the precious metal price currency. For future contracts, the Identifier is the exchange code for the future contract. Table the guide lists the allowable values for Name and gives a description. \\

fields.text: [Optional] The currency of the strike value. The strike value has to be in underlying quotation currency. fields.text: The schedule specifying the schedule of trading days over which the continuous barrier will be monitored. This is required only when BarrierStyle is American. \\ Allowable values: A node of the same form as ScheduleData, (see the guide).

fields.name: SettlementDate
fields.text: Settlement date of the option exercise payoff. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide. The Settlement date must be on or after the Option expiry date.

fields.name: PayCcy
fields.text: Settlement currency. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: OptionLongShort
fields.text: Specifies which party has the right to pre-pay the notional down to the lower notional bound. Short means that for pricing purposes pre-payments are assumed to be done in such a way to maximise the value of the Flexi Swap for the "other" counterparty, Long means that the Flexi Swap value is maximised from "our" point of view. Allowable values: Long or Short

fields.name: LegData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide.

fields.name: FvaDate
fields.text: The date on which the forward option strike is fixed and the fixed premium is observed. This is also the start of the forward period. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: OptionExpiry
fields.text: The expiry date of the forward-starting option. The floating payoff is determined by the spot price of the underlying on this date. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide. Must be strictly after FvaDate.

fields.name: PremiumDate
fields.text: The date on which the fixed premium is paid. Must be on or after FvaDate. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: Underlying
fields.text: The underlying asset definition. The ordering of FX currency pairs defines the observed value, i.e. for ECB-GBP-USD the domestic currency is USD (the value is expressed in USD per GBP). Allowable values: See the guide.

fields.name: LongShort
fields.text: Whether the party is long or short the forward volatility agreement. Allowable values: Long, Short.

fields.name: ImpliedVolStrike
fields.text: The pre-agreed annualised implied volatility used to compute the fixed premium. Expressed in absolute (decimal) terms, e.g. 0.09675 for 9.675%. Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.text: The notional quantity of the agreement. Allowable values: Any non-negative real number.

fields.name: PayCcy
fields.text: The currency in which the fixed premium and the floating payoff are settled. Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: SettlementDate
fields.text: The date on which the floating payoff is settled. Must be on or after OptionExpiry. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: UnderlyingStrike
fields.text: The strike of the forward-starting option, typically agreed at the at-the-money forward level on trade date. If omitted, the strike defaults at valuation time to the forward price of the underlying at the FVA date for option expiry (i.e.\ it is set to the at-the-money forward level consistent with the model). Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: PayoffType
fields.text: The payoff type of the FVA. Defaults to Straddle if omitted. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: PaymentDate
fields.text: The date of the settlement cash flow. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: ObservationDates
fields.text: Schedule data that determine the observation dates that are taken into account in the FX rate averaging. See section the guide

fields.name: FixedPayer
fields.text: If true, the payoff multiplier \omega is set to 1, otherwise -1. \\ Allowable values: true, false

fields.name: ReferenceNotional
fields.text: The amount to be converted into settlement currency at the average FX rate \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: ReferenceCurrency
fields.text: The currency of the reference notional above. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: SettlementNotional
fields.text: The fixed amount to be paid or received depending on the fixed payer flag above \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: SettlementCurrency
fields.text: The currency of the settlement notional above. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: FXIndex
fields.text: The FX reference index for determining the FX fixing for averaging. \\ Allowable values: The format of the FXIndex is "FX-FixingSource-CCY1-CCY2" as described in Table the guide. Notice that since the payoff is based on an arithmetic average, the order of the currencies in the FX index matters: The averaging will be done on fx rates quoted as CCY1-CCY2 (foreign-domestic).

fields.name: ValueDate
fields.text: The value date of the FxForward. The FX rate "fixes" on the ValueDate (i.e., the agreed fxforward rate is applied). Before the ValueDate, the FxForward contract's value fluctuates with market FX rates. At the ValueDate, the settlement becomes deterministic. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: BoughtCurrency
fields.text: The currency to be bought on value date. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: BoughtAmount
fields.text: The amount to be bought on value date. \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: SoldCurrency
fields.text: The currency to be sold on value date. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: SoldAmount
fields.text: The amount to be sold on value date. \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: Settlement
fields.text: Delivery type. Note that Non-Deliverable Forwards can be represented by Cash settlement. \\ Allowable values: Cash or Physical. Defaults to Physical if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: SettlementData
fields.text: This node is used to specify the settlement of the cash flows on the value date.

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The currency in which the FX Forward is settled. This field is only used if settlement is Cash. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency. Defaults to the sold currency if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: FXIndex
fields.text: The FX reference index for determining the FX fixing at the value date. The Forward Price will be observed at maturity date (or future expiry date if it’s a future), the NPV is converted to PayCurrency with the FXIndex using an FX fixing on FixingDate (settlement date) discounted from PaymentDate. \\ Allowable values: The format of the FXIndex is "FX-FixingSource-CCY1-CCY2" as described in Table the guide.

fields.name: Date
fields.text: If specified, this will be the payment date. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide. If left blank or omitted, the payment date will be derived from the maturity date applying the PaymentLag, PaymentCalendar and the PaymentConvention as defined in the Rules sub-node.

fields.name: Rules
fields.text: If Date is left blank or omitted, this node will be used to derive the payment date from the maturity date. The Rules sub-node is shown in Listing the guide, and the meanings and allowable values of its elements follow below. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. The relevant fields in the OptionData node for an FxOption are: \begin{itemize}

fields.name: NearDate
fields.text: The date of the initial fx exchange of the FX Swap. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: NearBoughtCurrency
fields.text: The currency to be bought in the initial exchange at near date, and sold in the final exchange at far date. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: NearBoughtAmount
fields.text: The amount to be bought on near date. \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: NearSoldCurrency
fields.text: The currency to be sold in the initial fx exchange at near date, and bought in the final exchange at far date. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: NearSoldAmount
fields.text: The amount to be sold on near date. \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: FarDate
fields.text: The date of the final fx exchange of the FX Swap. \\ Allowable values: Any date further into the future than NearDate. See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: FarBoughtAmount
fields.text: The amount to be bought on far date. \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: FarSoldAmount
fields.text: The amount to be sold on far date. \\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. The OptionType sub-node is not required and is inferred from the BarrierData type (i.e.\ Call for an Up barrier, and Put for a Down barrier). The relevant fields in the OptionData node for an FxTouchOption are: \begin{itemize}

fields.name: ForeignCurrency
fields.text: The foreign currency the notional of the leg resets to. Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: ForeignAmount
fields.text: The notional amount in the foreign currency that the notional of the leg resets to. Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: FXIndex
fields.text: A reference to an FX Index source for the FX reset fixing. Allowable values: A string of the form FX-SOURCE-CCY1-CCY2. Note that the FX- part of the string stays constant for all currency pairs. See Table the guide for further details, including supported FX-pairs for each fixing source.

fields.name: Position
fields.text: Defines whether the underlying power will be bought (long) or sold (short). \\ Allowable values: Long, Short

fields.name: Maturity
fields.text: The maturity date of the forward contract. \\ Allowable values: Any date string, see Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: Name
fields.text: The name of the underlying intraday power index or curve. \\ Allowable values: See Name for commodity trades in Table the guide.

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The currency the underlying power is quoted in. The strike and forward price are both considered to be in this currency. \\ Allowable values: See Currency in Table the guide.

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: The agreed buy/sell price of the intraday power forward. \\ Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.text: The number of total energy (in MWh) bought/sold. \\ Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: DeliveryDate
fields.text: Delivery date for the intraday power forward. \\ Allowable values: Any date string, see Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: DeliveryStart
fields.text: Start of delivery window, expressed in seconds from start of day on DeliveryDate. Must be provided together with DeliveryEnd when PowerLoadProfileData is not provided. \\ Allowable values: Any integer.

fields.name: DeliveryEnd
fields.text: End of delivery window, expressed in seconds from start of day on DeliveryDate. Must be provided together with DeliveryStart when PowerLoadProfileData is not provided. \\ Allowable values: Any integer.

fields.name: IsDstHour
fields.text: Flag to mark the repeated hour on backward-shift dates when using explicit delivery window representation. If omitted, it defaults to false. \\ Allowable values: Any string that evaluates to true or false as outlined in Table the guide.

fields.name: PowerLoadProfileData
fields.text: Alternative to DeliveryStart and DeliveryEnd. This defines delivery load by profile. One must provide either both DeliveryStart and DeliveryEnd, or PowerLoadProfileData. \\ Allowable values: See Section the guide.

fields.name: PhysicallySettled
fields.text: A value of true indicates physical settlement. A value of false indicates cash settlement. If omitted, it defaults to true. \\ Allowable values: Any string that evaluates to true or false as outlined in Table the guide.

fields.name: PaymentDate
fields.text: If PhysicallySettled is set to false, this gives the cash settlement date. It must be greater than or equal to the Maturity date. If omitted and the forward is cash settled, the Maturity date is used. \\ Allowable values: Any date string, see Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: SettlementData
fields.text: This node is used to specify the settlement of the cash flows for cash settled forwards, and the payment flow for physically settled ones.

fields.name: Payer
fields.text: The flows of the leg are paid to the counterparty if true, and received if false. Allowable values: true, false

fields.name: LegType
fields.text: Determines which of the available sub-nodes must be used. Allowable values: Fixed, Floating, Cashflow, CMS, CMB, DigitalCMS, DurationAdjustedCMS, CMSSpread, DigitalCMSSpread, Equity, CPI, YY, ZeroCouponFixed, FormulaBased, CommodityFloating, CommodityFixed, EquityMargin, RangeAccrual

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The currency of the leg. Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency. When LegType is Equity, Minor Currencies in Table the guide are also allowable.

fields.name: PaymentConvention
fields.text: The payment convention of the leg coupons. Allowable values: See Table the guide.

fields.name: PaymentLag
fields.text: The lag between the, adjusted or unadjusted (see PaymentLagAnchor below), reference schedule period end date and the payment date. Allowable values: Usually a number of days but any valid period is allowed. In other words, an integer followed by a string where the last character must be one of D, W, M or Y. Compound period definitions also work, for example 1Y6M and -6W4D. Note that compound periods only work for year and month pairs or week and day pairs. If left blank or omitted, it defaults to 0D. Note also that negative periods are allowed where they make sense.

fields.name: PaymentLagUnit
fields.text: Determines how the PaymentLag is used to calculate the payment date from an anchor date. If omitted, or BusinessDays is given, the PaymentLag is applied in the usual way. In other words the anchor date is shifted by the period defined by the PaymentLag using the PaymentCalendar and PaymentConvention. If CalendarDays is given, the PaymentLag period must have day units. In this case, the anchor date is shifted by PaymentLag calendar days. If the resulting date is not a good business day with respect to the PaymentCalendar, it is adjusted using the PaymentCalendar and PaymentConvention. The anchor date used for the payment date generation can be influenced by the PaymentLagAnchor below. Allowable values: BusinessDays or CalendarDays. Defaults to BusinessDays if omitted.

fields.name: PaymentLagAnchor
fields.text: Determines the base or anchor date to use when calculating a payment date using the PaymentLag. If omitted, or Adjusted is given, the anchor date is the underlying schedule date. This schedule date may have had adjustments applied. If Unadjusted is given, the anchor date is the underlying schedule date before any adjustments have been applied. Allowable values: Adjusted or Unadjusted. Defaults to Adjusted if omitted.

fields.name: NotionalPaymentLag
fields.text: The notional payment lag, in days, applied to any notional exchanges. Allowable values: Any integer that makes economic sense. In most cases, if non-zero, it is a small positive number of days. Defaults to zero if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: NotionalPaymentLagUnit
fields.text: This setting interacts with NotionalPaymentLag in the same way that PaymentLagUnit interacts with PaymentLag. See the relevant bullet points above for a description and allowable values.

fields.name: NotionalPaymentLagAnchor
fields.text: This setting interacts with NotionalPaymentLag in the same way that PaymentLagAnchor interacts with PaymentLag. See the relevant bullet points above for a description and allowable values.

fields.name: PaymentCalendar
fields.text: The payment calendar of the leg coupons. The PaymentCalendar is used in conjunction with the PaymentConvention, PaymentLag and NotionalPaymentLag to determine the payments dates, unless the PaymentDates node is used which defines the payment dates explicitly. Allowable values: See Table the guide Calendar. If left blank or omitted, it defaults to the calendar in the ScheduleData node, unless LegType is Floating and Index is OIS, in which case this defaults to the index fixing calendar. If the PaymentCalendar defaults to the calendar in the ScheduleData node, as is the case for non-OIS indices on floating legs, and no calendar is set in ScheduleData (for dates-based schedules the calendar field is optional), the NullCalendar is used.

fields.name: DayCounter
fields.text: The day count convention of the leg coupons. Note that DayCounter is mandatory for all leg types except Equity. Allowable values: See DayCount Convention in Table the guide. For Equity legs, if left blank or omitted, it defaults to ACT/365.

fields.name: Notionals
fields.text: This node contains child elements of type Notional. If the notional is fixed over the life of the leg only one notional value should be entered. If the notional is amortising or accreting, this is represented by entering multiple notional values, each represented by a Notional child element. The first notional value corresponds to the first coupon, the second notional value corresponds to the second coupon, etc. If the number of coupons exceeds the number of notional values, the notional will be kept flat at the value of last entered notional for the remaining coupons. The number of entered notional values cannot exceed the number of coupons. Allowable values: Each child element can take any positive real number. \vspace{1em} An example of a Notionals element for an amortising leg with four coupons is shown in Listing the guide. \begin{listing}[H] %\hrule\medskip \begin{minted}[fontsize=\footnotesize]{xml} <Notionals> <Notional>65000000</Notional> <Notional>65000000</Notional> <Notional>55000000</Notional> <Notional>45000000</Notional> </Notionals>

fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide Schedule Data and Dates.

fields.name: StrictNotionalDates
fields.text: If given and set to true, notional changes specified by startDate will be interpreted as taking place on the exact given date, even if that date falls into a calculation (accrual) period. Otherwise the notional change is applied for the next calculation period. Supported only for fixed and floating legs with IBOR / RFR term rate coupons.

fields.name: SettlementData
fields.text: This node is used to specify the settlement of the cash flows in a currency other than the commodity underlying currency. Only used for CommodityFixed and CommodityFloating leg types. This node will be ignored for other leg types. A SettlementData node is shown in Listing the guide, and the meanings and allowable values of its elements follow below. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: FixingDate

fields.name: Payer
