fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The currency of the leg. Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency. When LegType is Equity, Minor Currencies in Table the guide are also allowable.

fields.name: DayCounter
fields.text: The day count convention of the leg coupons. Note that DayCounter is mandatory for all leg types except Equity. Allowable values: See DayCount Convention in Table the guide. For Equity legs, if left blank or omitted, it defaults to ACT/365.

fields.name: PaymentConvention
fields.text: The payment convention of the leg coupons. Allowable values: See Table the guide.

fields.name: PaymentLag
fields.text: The lag between the, adjusted or unadjusted (see PaymentLagAnchor below), reference schedule period end date and the payment date. Allowable values: Usually a number of days but any valid period is allowed. In other words, an integer followed by a string where the last character must be one of D, W, M or Y. Compound period definitions also work, for example 1Y6M and -6W4D. Note that compound periods only work for year and month pairs or week and day pairs. If left blank or omitted, it defaults to 0D. Note also that negative periods are allowed where they make sense.

fields.name: PaymentLagUnit
fields.text: Determines how the PaymentLag is used to calculate the payment date from an anchor date. If omitted, or BusinessDays is given, the PaymentLag is applied in the usual way. In other words the anchor date is shifted by the period defined by the PaymentLag using the PaymentCalendar and PaymentConvention. If CalendarDays is given, the PaymentLag period must have day units. In this case, the anchor date is shifted by PaymentLag calendar days. If the resulting date is not a good business day with respect to the PaymentCalendar, it is adjusted using the PaymentCalendar and PaymentConvention. The anchor date used for the payment date generation can be influenced by the PaymentLagAnchor below. Allowable values: BusinessDays or CalendarDays. Defaults to BusinessDays if omitted.

fields.name: PaymentLagAnchor
fields.text: Determines the base or anchor date to use when calculating a payment date using the PaymentLag. If omitted, or Adjusted is given, the anchor date is the underlying schedule date. This schedule date may have had adjustments applied. If Unadjusted is given, the anchor date is the underlying schedule date before any adjustments have been applied. Allowable values: Adjusted or Unadjusted. Defaults to Adjusted if omitted.

fields.name: PaymentCalendar
fields.text: The payment calendar of the leg coupons. The PaymentCalendar is used in conjunction with the PaymentConvention, PaymentLag and NotionalPaymentLag to determine the payments dates, unless the PaymentDates node is used which defines the payment dates explicitly. Allowable values: See Table the guide Calendar. If left blank or omitted, it defaults to the calendar in the ScheduleData node, unless LegType is Floating and Index is OIS, in which case this defaults to the index fixing calendar. If the PaymentCalendar defaults to the calendar in the ScheduleData node, as is the case for non-OIS indices on floating legs, and no calendar is set in ScheduleData (for dates-based schedules the calendar field is optional), the NullCalendar is used.

fields.name: Notionals
fields.text: This node contains child elements of type Notional. If the notional is fixed over the life of the leg only one notional value should be entered. If the notional is amortising or accreting, this is represented by entering multiple notional values, each represented by a Notional child element. The first notional value corresponds to the first coupon, the second notional value corresponds to the second coupon, etc. If the number of coupons exceeds the number of notional values, the notional will be kept flat at the value of last entered notional for the remaining coupons. The number of entered notional values cannot exceed the number of coupons. Allowable values: Each child element can take any positive real number. \vspace{1em} An example of a Notionals element for an amortising leg with four coupons is shown in Listing the guide. \begin{listing}[H] %\hrule\medskip \begin{minted}[fontsize=\footnotesize]{xml} <Notionals> <Notional>65000000</Notional> <Notional>65000000</Notional> <Notional>55000000</Notional> <Notional>45000000</Notional> </Notionals>

fields.name: ScheduleData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide Schedule Data and Dates.

fields.name: Settlement
fields.text: the settlement date (optional, if not given defaults to the exercise date) \\ Allowable values: each valid date.

fields.name: ObservationDates
fields.text: the observation dates for the lookback call \\ Allowable values: See the definition in the guide

fields.name: Notional
fields.text: The quantity (for equity, commodity underlyings) / foreign amount (fx underlying) \\ Allowable values: all positive real numbers

fields.name: Underlyings
fields.text: The basket of underlyings. \\ Allowable values: for each underlying see the guide

fields.name: Settlement
fields.text: the settlement date (optional, if not given defaults to the exercise date) \\ Allowable values: each valid date.

fields.name: Notional
fields.text: The quantity (for equity, commodity underlyings) / foreign amount (fx underlying) \\ Allowable values: all positive real numbers

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: The strike of the option \\ Allowable values: all positive real numbers

fields.name: Underlyings
fields.text: The basket of underlyings. \\ Allowable values: for each underlying see the guide

fields.name: IssuerId
fields.text: A unique identifier for the index component reference entity. For informational purposes and not used for pricing. Allowable values: Any alphanumeric string. %\item Qualifier: SIMM qualifier. Not currently used. %Allowable values: Any string.

fields.name: CreditCurveId
fields.text: The unique identifier of the index component defining one of the default curves used for pricing. The pricing can be set up to either use the curve identifiers of the index components, or one single index curve id defined in the trade specific data. A ReferenceInformation node may be used in place of this CreditCurveId node. Allowable values: See CreditCurveId for credit trades - single name in Table the guide. Duplicate CreditCurveId:s are not allowed. \\

fields.name: ReferenceInformation
fields.text: This node may be used as an alternative to the CreditCurveId node to specify the reference entity, tier, currency and documentation clause for the basket constituent. This in turn defines the credit curve used for this basket constituent in the pricing. The ReferenceInformation node is described in further detail in Section the guide.

fields.name: Notional
fields.text: The notional of the index component reference entity. Note that the sum of index component notionals (all names) must match the fixed premium leg notional. Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: Weight
fields.text: Can be used, instead of Notional, to specify the weight of the index component reference entity. Note that the sum of index component notionals (all names) must match 1. Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: Defines the currency of the component, only mandatory together with a given notional.

fields.name: LongShort
fields.text: The allowable values are Long or Short. Note that for Swaptions the payer and receiver legs in the underlying swap are always from the perspective of the party that is Long. E.g. for a Short swaption with a fixed leg where the Payer flag is set to false, it means that the counterparty receives the fixed flows. \begin{table}[H] \centering \begin{tabular} {| c | c | c | c |} \hline LongShort & \makecell{Payer for Fixed leg \\ on underlying Swap} & \makecell{Payer for Floating leg \\ on underlying Swap} & Resulting Set Up and Flows \\ \hline Long & true & false & \makecell[l]{The Party to the trade buys an \\ option to enter a swap where the \\ Party pays fixed and receives \\ floating} \\ \hline Short & true & false & \makecell[l]{The Party to the trade sells an \\ option to the Counterparty to enter \\ a swap where the Counterparty \\ pays fixed and receives floating} \\ \hline Long & false & true & \makecell[l]{The Party to the trade buys an \\ option to enter a swap where the \\ Party receives fixed and pays \\ floating} \\ \hline Short & false & true & \makecell[l]{The Party to the trade sells an \\ option to the Counterparty to enter \\ a swap where the Counterparty \\ receives fixed and pays floating} \\ \hline

fields.name: OptionType
fields.text: This flag is optional for swaptions, and even if set, has no impact. Whether a swaption is a payer or receiver swaption is determined by the Payer flags on the legs of the underlying swap.

fields.name: Style
fields.text: The exercise style of the Swaption. The allowable values are European, Bermudan or American.

fields.name: NoticePeriod
fields.text: The notice period defining the date (relative to the exercise date) on which the exercise decision has to be taken. If not given the notice period defaults to 0D, i.e. the notice date is identical to the exercise date. Allowable values: A number followed by D, W, M, or Y

fields.name: NoticeCalendar
fields.text: The calendar used to compute the notice date from the exercise date. If not given defaults to the NullCalendar (no holidays, weekends are no holidays either). Allowable values: See Table the guide Calendar.

fields.name: NoticeConvention
fields.text: The roll convention used to compute the notice date from the exercise date. Defaults to Unadjusted if not given. Allowable values: See Table the guide Roll Convention.

fields.name: MidCouponExercise
fields.text: If false, the exercise-into underlying comprises all coupons with accrual start date greater or equal to notification date. I.e. one exercises into the next coupon, not the current one.\\ If true, the exercise-into underlying comprises all coupons with accrual end date greater than the effective exercise date which is computed from the notification date by adding the notice period. The accrual paid for such coupons on exercise is calculated from the effective exercise date to the accrual end date (short coupon). Allowable values: true, false. If omitted, defaults to false for European and Bermudan swaptions and true for American swaptions.

fields.name: Settlement
fields.text: Delivery Type. The allowable values are Cash or Physical. Note that for TradeType CallableSwap only Physical is allowed. Also note that Cash means the last Exercise date will be the Maturity date, whereas for Physical the Maturity date will be the End date of the underlying Swap.

fields.name: SettlementMethod
fields.text: Specifies the method to calculate the settlement amount for Swaptions and CallableSwaps. Allowable values: PhysicalOTC, PhysicalCleared, CollateralizedCashPrice, ParYieldCurve. Defaults to ParYieldCurve if Settlement is Cash and defaults to PhysicalOTC if Settlement is Physical. PhysicalOTC = OTC traded swaptions with physical settlement\\ PhysicalCleared = Cleared swaptions with physical settlement\\ CollateralizedCashPrice = Cash settled swaptions with settlement price calculation using zero coupon curve discounting \\ ParYieldCurve = Cash settled swaptions with settlement price calculation using par yield discounting \footnote{https://www.isda.org/book/2006-isda-definitions/} \footnote{https://www.isda.org/a/TlAEE/Supplement-No-58-to-ISDA-2006-Definitions.pdf} \\

fields.name: Premiums
fields.text: Option premium node with amounts paid by the option buyer to the option seller. Can also be specified using the legacy fields PremiumAmount, PremiumCurrency, and PremiumPayDate. Allowable values: See section the guide

fields.name: ExerciseFees
fields.text: This node contains child elements of type ExerciseFee. Similar to a list of notionals (see the guide) the fees can be given either \begin{itemize}

fields.name: PayCurrency
fields.text: The settlement currency for the payment cashflow. \\ Allowable values: See Currency in Table the guide.

fields.name: FXIndex
fields.text: The FX reference index for determining the FX fixing at the value date. The Forward Price will be observed at maturity date (or future expiry date if it’s a future), the NPV is converted to PayCurrency with the FXIndex using an FX fixing on FixingDate (settlement date) discounted from PaymentDate. \\ Allowable values: The format of the FXIndex is "FX-FixingSource-CCY1-CCY2" as described in Table the guide.

fields.name: FixingDate
fields.text: The date on which the FXIndex is observed. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: LongShort
fields.text: Own party position. \\ Allowable values: Long, Short

fields.name: Underlyings
fields.text: The basket of underlyings. \\ Allowable values: The format follows that of a scripted trade underlying. See the scripted trade documentation in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade (section Data Node / Index) for allowable values.

fields.name: UnderlyingStrikes
fields.text: The volatility strikes K^{1,2}_{vol} of the underlyings quoted in absolute terms. If the swap was struck in terms of variance, the square roots of the variances should be used here. \\ Allowable values: Any non-negative number, as a percentage expressed in decimal form.

fields.name: UnderlyingNotionals
fields.text: The vega notional amount. If the swap was struck in terms of variance notionals N_{var}, the corresponding vega notionals are given by N^{1,2}_{vol} = N^{1,2}_{var} \cdot 2 \cdot 100 \cdot K^{1,2}_{vol} (where K^{1,2}_{vol} is in absolute terms). \\ Allowable values: Any non-negative number.

fields.name: Amount
fields.text: Option premium amounts paid by the option buyer to the option seller. A positive amount is considered to be paid by the option holder to the option seller and thus results in a negative contribution to the NPV of a long option. \\ Allowable values: arbitrary number

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: Currency of the premium to be paid\\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: PayDate
fields.text: Date of the premium payment.\\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: SettlementData
fields.text: Converts the premium into a currency different. It specifies the payment currency, the FX index to perform the conversion, and the date on which the FX rate is fixed. Its XML form is shown in listing the guide. \begin{itemize}

fields.name: PayCurrency
fields.text: The settlement currency for the payment cashflow. \\ Allowable values: See Currency in Table the guide.

fields.name: FXIndex
fields.text: The FX reference index for determining the FX fixing at the value date. The Forward Price will be observed at maturity date (or future expiry date if it’s a future), the NPV is converted to PayCurrency with the FXIndex using an FX fixing on FixingDate (settlement date) discounted from PaymentDate. \\ Allowable values: The format of the FXIndex is "FX-FixingSource-CCY1-CCY2" as described in Table the guide.

fields.name: FixingDate
fields.text: The date on which the FXIndex is observed. Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: RangeFrom
fields.text: The lower bound of the range. Allowable values: Any real number. If omitted, no lower bound applies. Cannot be left blank.

fields.name: RangeTo
fields.text: The upper bound of the range. Allowable values: Any real number. If omitted, no lower bound applies. Cannot be left blank.

fields.name: Leverage
fields.text: The leverage that applies to the range. For TaRFs, negative leverage can be mixed with positive leverage to reflect a TaRF with switching buyer/seller. However, for Accumulators all given Leverage parameters within the same instrument (in multiple RangeBound nodes) must have the same sign. Allowable values: Any real number. Defaults to 1 if omitted. Cannot be left blank.

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: The strike specific to the range. If given overwrites a strike given on the trade level. Allowable values: Any real number. Defaults to the trade level strike if omitted. Cannot be left blank.

fields.name: StrikeAdjustment
fields.text: A strike adjustment relative to the strike given on the trade level. If given the strike for the defined range is computed as K+A where K is the strike on the trade level and A is the strike adjustment. Notice that Strike and StrikeAdjustment can not be given both at the same time. Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: This is a trade component sub-node outlined in section the guide. The relevant fields in the OptionData node for a RateDigitalOption are: \begin{itemize}

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: the option description, see the guide, the relevant / allowed data is \begin{itemize}

fields.name: Rules
fields.text: a sub-node that determines whether the schedule is set by specifying rules that generate the schedule. If existing, the following entries are required: StartDate, EndDate, Tenor, Calendar, Convention, and Rule. EndDateConvention is optional. If not existing, a Dates or Derived sub-node is required.

fields.name: Dates
fields.text: a sub-node that determines that the schedule is set by specifying schedule dates explicitly.

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The payoff currency. \\ %if OptionType is Call, \\ and receive currency if OptionType is Put. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.text: The quantity of the underlying equities. See payoff formula above. \\ Allowable values: all positive real numbers

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: The strike of the option, expressed as amount of CCY2 per one unit of CCY1. \\ Allowable values: all positive real numbers

fields.name: StrikeData
fields.text: A node containing the strike in Value and the currency in which both the underlying and the strike are quoted in Currency. Allowable values: See Currency in Table the guide. The strike may be any positive real number. The currency provided in this node may be quoted as corresponding minor currency to the underlying major currency.

fields.name: Underlying
fields.text: One (and only one) Underlying node where Type must be set to Equity. \\ Allowable values: See the guide. Note that the equity must be quoted in the Currency above.

fields.name: OptionData
fields.text: The relevant fields in the OptionData node for an EquityAsianOption are the LongShort flag, the OptionType (call/put), the PayoffType which must be set to Asian or AverageStrike to identify a fixed or floating strike asian payoff, and the ExerciseDates node where exactly one ExerciseDate date element must be given. PayoffType2 can be optionally set to Arithmetic or Geometric and defaults to Arithmetic if not given. Furthermore, a Premiums node can be added to represent deterministic option premia to be paid by the option holder.\\ Allowable values: See the guide for the general structure of the option data node

fields.name: Settlement
fields.text: The settlement date. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide. Defaults to the ExerciseDate if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: ObservationDates
fields.text: The observation dates for the asian period, given as a rules-based or dates-based schedule, analogous to a ScheduleData node but called ObservationDates. \\ Allowable values: See the definition in the guide

fields.name: Value
fields.text: The strike price. Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: Compounding
fields.text: The compounding or the yield given in Yield. Allowable values: Simple, Compounded, Continuous, SimpleThenCompounded. Defaults to SimpleThenCompounded if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: Yield
fields.text: A Yield quoted in decimal form, e.g. 10% should be entered as 0.1. Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: RoundNettedFloatingLegs
fields.text: Boolean flag to enable floating leg netting. When set to true, all floating leg cashflows with the same payment date are netted into a single cashflow. Fixed legs are processed normally and are not affected by netting. Defaults to false.

fields.name: NettingPrecision
fields.text: Number of decimal places to round the total average fixing before multiplying by the quantity. Only applies when RoundNettedFloatingLegs is true. If not specified, no rounding is applied to the netted fixing.

fields.name: Settlement
fields.text: Delivery type applicable to cross currency swaps, and ignored for all other swap types. Delivery type does not impact pricing in ORE, but npv results are produced with and without SIMM exemptions. Settlement Cash indicates that principal exchanges on the cross currency swap should be included in Initial Margin (IM). According to ISDA non-deliverable (Cash) trades are excluded from the exemption from IM for the principal exchange, i.e. the principal exchanges are included in IM. Settlement Physical indicates that principal exchanges on the cross currency swap should be excluded in IM (the ISDA exemption applies). Allowable values: Cash or Physical. Defaults to Physical if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: Type
fields.text: The type of the Underlying asset. Allowable values: Equity, FX, Commodity, InterestRate, Inflation, Credit, Bond

fields.name: Name
fields.text: The name of the Underlying asset. Allowable values: Equity: See Name for equity trades in Table the guide FX: A string on the form SOURCE-CCY1-CCY2, where SOURCE is the FX fixing source, and the fixing is expressed as amount in CCY2 per one unit of CCY1. See Table the guide, and note that the FX- prefix is not included in Name as it is already included in Type. InterestRate: Any valid interest rate index name, see Table the guide Inflation: Any valid zero coupon inflation index (CPI) name, See Table the guide Credit: Any valid credit name with a configured default curve, see Table the guide Bond: Any valid bond identifier, the bond must be set up in the reference data. Commodity: An identifier specifying the commodity being referenced in the leg. % The following needs to move into client-specific documentation of allowable values: %The Name is of the form Prefix:Identifier. The Prefix is either PM for precious metal or a code representing the exchange on which the commodity is traded. For precious metals, the Identifier is the precious metal code followed by the precious metal price currency. For future contracts, the Identifier is the exchange code for the future contract. Table the guide lists the allowable values for Name and gives a description. \\

fields.name: IdentifierType
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Equity or Bond. The type of the identifier being used. Allowable values: RIC, ISIN, FIGI, BBG. Defaults to RIC, if left blank or omitted, and Type: is Equity.

fields.name: Weight
fields.text: The relative weight of the underlying if part of a basket. For a single underlying this can be omitted or set to 1. Allowable values: A real number. Defaults to 1 if left blank or omitted. A value of zero means that the underlying is excluded from the basket. Notes on negative weights in the TotalReturnSwap trade type: Negative weights for EquityOptionPositions are allowed, but not recommended. A negative weight for an EquityOptionPosition is equivalent to inverting the LongShort flag in the respective OptionData node. For EquityPositions a negative weight means that flows are in the opposite direction of the Payer flag on the return leg. A use case for negative weights is for a basket of EquityPositions that include both long and short positions.

fields.name: PriceType
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Commodity. Whether the Spot or Future price is referenced. Allowable values: Spot, FutureSettlement. Mandatory when Type is Commodity .

fields.name: FutureMonthOffset
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Commodity. Only relevant for the FutureSettlement price type, in which case the N+1th future with expiry greater than ObservationDate for the given commodity underlying will be referenced. Allowable values: An integer. Mandatory for when Type is Commodity and PriceType is FutureSettlement.

fields.name: DeliveryRollDays
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Commodity. The number of days the observation date is rolled forward before the next future expiry is looked up. Allowable values: An integer. Defaults to 0 if left blank or omitted, and Type: is Commodity.

fields.name: DeliveryRollCalendar
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Commodity. The calendar used to roll forward the observation date. Allowable values: See Table the guide. Defaults to the null calendar if left blank or omitted, and Type: is Commodity.

fields.name: FutureExpiryDate
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Commodity, PriceType is FutureSettlement and there is no FutureContractMonth node. This gives the expiration date of the underlying commodity future contract. If the field FutureExpiryDate and FutureContractMonth are omitted, the expiration date of the underlying commodity future contract is set to the prompt future, adjusted for any FutureMonthOffset.

fields.name: FutureContractMonth
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Commodity, PriceType is FutureSettlement and there is no FutureExpiryDate node. It specifies the underlying future contract month in the format MonYYYY, for example Nov2023.

fields.name: Interpolation
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Inflation. The index observation interpolation between fixings. Allowable values: Flat, Linear

fields.name: BidAskAdjustment
fields.text: Only valid when Type is Bond. A correction applied to the price found in the market data (usually mid), if the bond basket price is defined on the bid or ask side rather than mid. Allowable values: Any real number.

fields.name: Settlement
fields.text: the settlement date (optional, if not given defaults to the exercise date) \\ Allowable values: each valid date.

fields.name: Notional
fields.text: The quantity (for equity, commodity underlyings) / foreign amount (fx underlying) \\ Allowable values: all positive real numbers

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: The strike of the option \\ Allowable values: all positive real numbers

fields.name: Underlyings
fields.text: The basket of underlyings. \\ Allowable values: for each underlying see the guide

fields.name: StartDate
fields.text: The variance swap start date. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.text: The variance swap end date. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide.

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The bought currency of the variance swap. \\ Allowable values: See Currency in Table the guide.

fields.name: Name
fields.text: The identifier of the underlying equity or equity index. \\ Allowable values: See Name for equity trades in Table the guide. \\

fields.name: Underlying
fields.text: This node may be used as an alternative to the Name node to specify the underlying equity. This in turn defines the equity curve used for pricing. The Underlying node is described in further detail in Section the guide. \\

fields.name: LongShort
fields.text: Defines whether the trade is long in the equity variance. For the avoidance of doubt, a long variance swap has positive value if the realised variance exceeds the variance strike. \\ Allowable values: Long, Short

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: The volatility strike K_{vol} of the variance swap quoted absolutely (i.e. not as a percent). If the swap was struck in terms of variance, the square root of that variance should be used here.\\ Allowable values: Any positive real number.

fields.name: Notional
fields.text: The vega notional of the variance swap. This is the notional in terms of volatility units (like the strike). If the swap was struck in terms of a variance notional N_{var}, the corresponding vega notional is given by N_{vol} = N_{var} * 2 * 100 * K_{vol} (where K_{vol} is in absolute terms).\\ Allowable values: Any non-negative real number.

fields.name: Calendar
fields.text: The calendar determining the observation/fixing dates according to which variance is accrued is the combination of the calendar(s) given here plus the calendar associated with the equity in the equity curve configuration. If no such calendar is given in the equity curve configuration the standard calendar for the equity currency (also defined in the curve config) is used instead. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide.

fields.name: MomentType
fields.text: A flag to distinguish if the swap is struck in terms of volatility or variance. The MomentType should be set to Volatility or Variance depending on the payoff. Note that MomentType does not necessarily need to be equivalent to the way the Strike is quoted which is always as a Volatility. \\ Allowable values: Volatility or Variance. Defaults to Variance if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: AddPastDividends
fields.text: A flag to distinguish if past dividend payments should be added to the fixings when calculating accrued variance. \\ Allowable values: true or false. Defaults to false if left blank or omitted.

fields.name: LongShort
fields.text: Own party position. \\ Allowable values: Long, Short

fields.name: Currency
fields.text: The payout currency for all cashflows. For FX, this should be CCY2 as defined (see Table the guide) in the Name field in the Underlying node. Note that for (non-quanto) FxWorstOfBasketSwaps, this should be the domestic (CCY2) currency, as defined in the Name field in the Underlying node. For non-quanto Equity- and CommodityWorstOfBasketSwaps, this should be currency the equity or commodity is quoted in. Notice Section "Payment Currency" in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade. \\ Allowable values: See Table the guide Currency.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.text: The equity notional amount, or the quantity multiplier. \\ Allowable values: Any number.

fields.name: InitialFixedRate
fields.text: The coupon rate for the initial fixed payment, to be paid to the Long party. \\ Allowable values: Any number, as a percentage expressed in decimal form. If left blank or omitted, defaults to zero.

fields.name: InitialFixedPayDate
fields.text: Settlement date for the initial fixed payment. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide. If left blank or omitted, this defaults to the first date in the FloatingPayDates schedule.

fields.name: Underlyings
fields.text: The basket of underlyings. \\ Allowable values: For each underlying, see the guide.

fields.name: InitialPrices
fields.text: The observed price of each underlying in Underlyings. \\ Allowable values: For each underlying, an InitialPrice sub-node with any positive number.

fields.name: KnockInPayDate
fields.text: Settlement date for the knock-in payment, subject to a knock-in event having been triggered. \\ Allowable values: See Date in Table the guide. If left blank or omitted, this defaults to the last date in the FloatingPayDates schedule.

fields.name: FloatingPeriodSchedule
fields.text: Period dates used for calculating floating coupon accrual fractions, and for observing underlying prices for calculating performances. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates/Rules, or DerivedSchedule for scripted trades (see the Event data structure in the scripted trade documentation at ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade).

fields.name: FloatingFixingSchedule
fields.text: Fixing dates for floating coupons linked to Ibor indices. The d^\text{th} date in this schedule is the fixing date for the (d+1)^\text{th} date in the FloatingPayDates. For floating coupons linked to overnight indices this scheulde is not relevant, the fixing dates are derived from the FloatingPeriodScheudle and FloatingLookback. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates/Rules, or DerivedSchedule for scripted trades (see the Event data structure in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade). If left blank or omitted, defaults to a DerivedSchedule with the FloatingPeriodSchedule set as the base schedule.

fields.name: FixedDeterminationSchedule
fields.text: If AccruingFixedCoupons is False, the observation dates on which a fixed trigger event is evaluated, upon which a fixed coupon payout is made. Otherwise, there is no payout. If AccruingFixedCoupons is True, these will be the dates on which fixed coupon amounts are calculated. The coupon amount is scaled by the number of fixed trigger days relative to the total number of days in the period. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates/Rules, or DerivedSchedule for scripted trades (see the Event data structure in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade). If left blank or omitted, defaults to a DerivedSchedule with the FloatingPeriodSchedule set as the base schedule.

fields.name: FloatingPayDates
fields.text: Floating coupon payment dates. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates, Rules, or DerivedSchedule (see ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade).

fields.name: FixedPayDates
fields.text: Fixed coupon payment dates. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates/Rules, or DerivedSchedule for scripted trades (see the Event data structure in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade). If left blank or omitted, defaults to the FloatingPayDates.

fields.name: KnockOutDeterminationSchedule
fields.text: Dates on which a knock-out event is evaluated, after which the instrument is considered to be terminated and no payout is made. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates/Rules, or DerivedSchedule for scripted trades (see the Event data structure in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade). If left blank or omitted, defaults to a DerivedSchedule with the FloatingPeriodSchedule set as the base schedule.

fields.name: FixedAccrualSchedule
fields.text: The fixed coupon paid out for each determination date in the FixedDeterminationSchedule is scaled according to the number of days in the FixedAccrualSchedule for which a fixed trigger event occurred, as a fraction of the total number of days in the period (defined by the FixedDeterminationSchedule). If AccruingFixedCoupons is True, this node is required. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates/Rules, or DerivedSchedule for scripted trades (see the Event data structure in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade).

fields.name: KnockOutLevels
fields.text: For each determination date in KnockOutDeterminationSchedule except for the first date, the barrier level used to determine whether a knock-out trigger event has occurred, resulting in a knock-out (i.e.\ contract termination). \\ Allowable values: For each knock-out determination date, a KnockOutLevel sub-node with any positive number, as a percentage of the initial prices, expressed in decimal form.

fields.name: BermudanKnockIn
fields.text: Whether the knock-in event is observed on a regular basis (True), as defined by the KnockInDeterminationSchedule, or only at the final date in the FloatingPeriodSchedule (False). \\ Allowable values: Boolean node, allowing Y, N, 1, 0, true, false, etc. The full set of allowable values is given in Table the guide. If left blank or omitted, defaults to False.

fields.name: FixedTriggerLevels
fields.text: For each fixed trigger determination date, the barrier level used to determine whether a coupon trigger event has occurred, upon which a fixed coupon is paid out at the corresponding payment date. \\ Allowable values: For each fixed trigger evaluation date, a FixedTriggerLevel sub-node with any positive number, as a percentage of the initial prices expressed in decimal form.

fields.name: KnockInLevel
fields.text: The barrier level used to determine whether a knock-in event has occurred for the given knock-in observation date/s, upon which the equity amount is payable at the KnockInPayDate, subject to no knock-out event having occurred over the life of the contract. \\ Allowable values: Any number, as a percentage of the initial prices expressed in decimal form.

fields.name: KnockInDeterminationSchedule
fields.text: Observation dates for determining if a knock-in event has occurred. If BermudanKnockIn is True, this node is required. \\ Allowable values: See section the guide Schedule Data and Dates/Rules, or DerivedSchedule for scripted trades (see the Event data structure in ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade).

fields.name: FixedRate
fields.text: Rate of the fixed coupon leg. \\ Allowable values: Any number, as a percentage expressed in decimal form.

fields.name: AccumulatingFixedCoupons
fields.text: Whether the fixed coupons are accumulating or not. \\ Allowable values: Boolean node, allowing Y, N, 1, 0, true, false, etc. The full set of allowable values is given in Table the guide. If left blank or omitted, defaults to False.

fields.name: AccruingFixedCoupons
fields.text: Whether the fixed coupons are paid out on an accrual basis (True), or subject to a single fixed trigger event (given by the FixedDeterminationSchedule). \\ Allowable values: Boolean node, allowing Y, N, 1, 0, true, false, etc. The full set of allowable values is given in Table the guide. If left blank or omitted, defaults to False.

fields.name: FloatingIndex
fields.text: Underlying index of the floating leg. \\ Allowable values: See ore/Docs/ScriptedTrade (section Data Node / Index). This must be an InterestRate underlying. Overnight indices are not supported.

fields.name: FloatingSpread
fields.text: Spread on the floating rate. \\ Allowable values: Any number. If left blank or omitted, defaults to zero.

fields.name: FloatingLookback
fields.text: Only applicable when the floating leg reference rate is an overnight index. The shift applied to each value date in FloatingFixingSchedule to obtain the fixing reference date. \\ Allowable values: Any period definition in unit "Days" (e.g.\ 2D, 30D, but not 1M). If omitted or left blank, defaults to 0D.

fields.name: FloatingRateCutoff
fields.text: Only applicable when the floating leg reference rate is an overnight index. The number of fixing dates at the end of the fixing period for which the fixing value is held constant and set to the previous value. \\ Allowable values: Any non-negative whole number. If left blank or omitted, defaults to zero.

fields.name: FloatingDayCountFraction
fields.text: The day count fraction for the floating leg accrual calculations. \\ Allowable values: See DayCount Convention in Table the guide.

fields.name: IsAveraged
fields.text: Only applicable when the floating leg reference rate is an overnight index (where there are multiple fixings over a period). If True, the average of the fixings is used to calculate the coupon. If False, the coupon is calculated by compounding the fixings. \\ Allowable values: Boolean node, allowing Y, N, 1, 0, true, false, etc. The full set of allowable values is given in Table the guide. Defaults to false If left blank or omiited.

fields.name: IncludeSpread
fields.text: Only applicable when the floating leg reference rate is an overnight index and if IsAveraged is false, i.e.\ the coupon rate is compounded. If true the spread is included in the compounding, otherwise it is excluded. \\ Allowable values: Boolean node, allowing Y, N, 1, 0, true, false, etc. The full set of allowable values is given in Table the guide.

fields.name: Strike
fields.text: Strike price for each underlying in the basket. When calculating the equity amount, this is the price used to calculate the number of shares (for Equity underlyings) owing of the worst-performing asset. \\ Allowable values: Any number, as a percentage of the initial prices, expressed in decimal form. If left blank or omitted, defaults to one, i.e.\ the initial price of the underlying.

without_element.CommodityPairwiseVarianceSwap: ORE has no trade builder for CommodityPairwiseVarianceSwap, as the trade type catalogue's unsupported types record; it is booked as a ScriptedTrade over the PairwiseVarianceSwap script
